rounds.name: Dardanelles Strait
rounds.fact: The Dardanelles connects the Aegean Sea with the Sea of Marmara and has served as a strategic military choke point.

rounds.name: Vancouver Island
rounds.fact: Vancouver Island lies along Canada’s Pacific Coast, separated from the mainland by the Strait of Georgia.

rounds.name: Falkland Islands
rounds.fact: The Falkland Islands are an archipelago in the South Atlantic Ocean on the Patagonian Shelf.

rounds.name: Sri Lanka / Palk Strait
rounds.fact: The Palk Strait is a shallow water body between the Tamil Nadu state of India and the northern tip of Sri Lanka.

rounds.name: Gulf of Guinea Coast
rounds.fact: The Gulf of Guinea represents the northeasternmost part of the tropical Atlantic Ocean off western Africa.
